request.style: English, female solo voice with choral backing, piano, strings, harp, flute, majestic and hopeful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A virgin pledged to Joseph of David's line
The angel came to say a sacred sign
She was deeply troubled by the sudden light
Wondering what this greeting could be right

[Pre-Chorus]
But the angel spoke with gentle grace
Do not be afraid in this place
You have found favor with God
A promise made to stand apart

[Chorus]
You will conceive a son of might
Name him Jesus in the light
He will be called the Son of the Most High
Greatness rising from the sky

[Verse]
The Lord God gives the throne of David
To reign over the house of Jacob
Forever his kingdom shall remain
No shadow of doubt in the air
His rule will never end or cease
A power beyond our reach

[Chorus]
You will conceive a son of might
Name him Jesus in the light
He will be called the Son of the Most High
Greatness rising from the sky

[Bridge]
How will this be she asked with care
Since I have not known a man
The Holy Spirit comes upon
Power of the Most High span

[Chorus]
You will conceive a son of might
Name him Jesus in the light
He will be called the Son of the Most High
Greatness rising from the sky

[Outro]
His kingdom will never end
Forever his reign begins
